title: Department of Public Services | City of College Park
column7: The City's Department of Public Services manages public safety and the Contract Police Program; the page does not identify a city police department.

title: Public Safety & Emergency Preparedness | City of College Park
column7: The City routes emergency and non-emergency incident reporting to Prince George's County Police and publishes PGPD monthly crime maps for incidents within city limits.

title: Department of Public Services | City of College Park
column7: The City states that its Contract Police Program provides off-duty Prince George's County police officers to supplement the County's regular police services within the City.

title: CITY OF COLLEGE PARK FY24 Adopted Budget
key_finding: The City budget explicitly says the City does not have a Police Department and that police services are provided through the University of Maryland Police Department and contractual arrangements with Prince George's County.

title: CITY OF COLLEGE PARK FY23 Adopted Budget
key_finding: The Contract Police program is described as enhancing and supplementing five agencies with primary or concurrent jurisdiction, and it identifies PGPD as having primary jurisdiction citywide.

title: An Assessment of Public Safety and Police Services in College Park Maryland
publisher: Police Foundation for the City of College Park
key_finding: The assessment says PGPD is the local law-enforcement agency with primary jurisdiction throughout the city and recommends remaining under the current policing structure in the short term.

title: Jurisdiction | University of Maryland Police Department
key_finding: UMPD states that it has primary jurisdiction on university property and concurrent jurisdiction in adjacent parts of College Park, while PGPD remains the primary agency for off-campus investigations in that concurrent-jurisdiction area.

title: UNIVERSITY OF MARYLAND POLICE DEPARTMENT Annual Security Report
key_finding: The annual security report reiterates that UMPD's PGPD agreement covers adjacent parts of College Park but that PGPD is the primary investigating agency off campus.
